data.body:
Closing entry for the consolidation session (2026-08-29).

Final state: epic compliant-lemon-grunion (759e-7dc1-675c-4877) has 12 children — nine new (celestine-treasonous-ewe corpus builder; expectable-clownlike-ynambu labels + noise floor; bouncy-peacockish-titmouse Tier-0 Pass-3 replay; presolar-finable-binturong Tier-1 Pass-2 replay; peaceable-choppy-sapsucker Tier-2 Pass-1 replay; fizzy-hypnotic-boto budget ledger; magnesian-subjective-ocelot model-parity guard; undamaged-adept-xenarthra usage-log ticket-id bug; furred-uneasy-platypus ADR + docs) and three folded in (ridiculous-expert-mouse, auspicious-torrid-curlew, brutal-idiocratic-rodent converted epic→story). Dependency chain: corpus → labels → tier 0 → tier 1 → tier 2 → protocol; ledger depends on the usage-log bug; tier 1 depends on ledger + parity. File impact recorded on all nine new children and on paternal-repayable-flamingo so next-batch schedules conflict-aware; next-batch currently returns undamaged-adept-xenarthra as immediately workable.

Disposition of pre-existing tickets: jira-reb-529 closed open→closed with close_class=superseded (link-backed disposition, attestation skipped, no LLM); jira-reb-1589 and fort-wisp-wren depend_on the epic; spin-cub-usher, yip-gem-teak, pastoral-aquatic-viper linked relates_to. Comments left on every touched ticket. Production bug paternal-repayable-flamingo (P1) filed discovered_from the epic: prompt caching 0% since 2026-08-12 from the mixed Bedrock+Anthropic class fallback, median review cost $2.18→$4.82.

Design decisions worth carrying forward: (1) no cheaper-model substitution in evals — the parity guard makes it a refusal, not a convention; (2) offline-first, consistent with ADR 0054 and epic 6982's no-live-A/B directive; (3) $200 cap with $30 reserve enforced by ledger pre-flight; (4) a change counts as improving/regressing only outside the noise band from the 208 identical-material verdict flips and the Tier-1 reproduction run. The epic description is 7,978 chars (under the 8,000 review-admission cap). No code changed; no billable gate ops run. The untracked reb-3115-*.py files in the repo root are unrelated held-out tests from a closed reconciler epic and were left untouched.
